items.name: Victuals bootstrap
items.description: Install and validate the minimum tools required to render and execute the Victuals workflow.

items.name: Full system update
items.description: Refresh package metadata and apply available Ubuntu updates.

items.name: Remove and pin Snap
items.description: Remove installed Snap applications and prevent snapd from returning.

items.name: Performance baseline
items.description: Apply the tracked TLP, thermald, GNOME, and service policy for a responsive workstation.

items.name: Integrated graphics power mode
items.description: Select Intel-only PRIME mode for battery-oriented operation.

items.name: NVIDIA compute mode
items.description: Select NVIDIA on-demand PRIME mode for local-model and CUDA work.

items.name: GNOME tiling policy
items.description: Install exactly one selected GNOME Shell tiling extension and disable managed alternatives.

items.name: Shell baseline
items.description: Install and configure the command-line tools used by the tracked shell profiles.

items.name: Kanata keyboard service
items.description: Install one privileged system keyboard-remapping service and validate its keymap.
